confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback text search, rendered methods pages, and the publisher supplement route were checked. Stimulus reconstruction, SOA/baseline timing, task families, and response rules are mostly reported, but exact PPS trial counts, repetition counts, ITI/jitter, response timeout, and detailed tactile calibration remain unavailable because the supplementary DOCX route was blocked by a JavaScript/Cookie challenge.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The PPS task can be recreated as a Canzoneri/Ferroni-style two-speaker looming-vs-flat pink-noise task with D0-D5 tactile timings. Exact participant-level trial counts, baseline/catch split, tactile calibration details, and response timeout would need approximation or the supplementary file.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 4-6 for Design and experimental procedure, the PPS task, Figure 1, and separation of PPS from the MTT task.
Used as the primary text map for candidate Segment 1-4 values, then checked against rendered methods pages.
Targeted searches for PPS task, pink noise, loudspeaker, looming, flat, D0-D5, catch, baseline, trial, random, ITI, response, and repetition terms.
Visual page check for methods layout and to prevent importing MTT-task counts into the PPS metadata.
Supplement route was found from the publisher page, but direct download was blocked by a Cloudflare JavaScript/Cookie challenge in this environment.

review_attempts.result: Mapped candidate Segment 1-4 values across 20 of 25 fields, including several MTT-task false positives.
Separated the PPS audio-tactile metadata from the later Mental Time Travel task; excluded the MTT 24/72 trial counts from PPS counts.
Confirmed pink-noise 3000 ms sounds, 44.1 kHz sampling, flat and looming conditions, 55-70 dB exponential looming gain, 62.5 dB flat sound, and two-speaker near/far geometry.
Confirmed D1-D5 tactile delays of 300, 800, 1500, 2200, and 2700 ms, plus a D0 tactile-only baseline at -700 ms during silence.
Confirmed 60% audio-tactile target trials and a 40% remainder containing auditory-only catches and unimodal tactile baselines, but no exact PPS total or split.
Rendered pages 4-6 were checked visually to verify where the PPS task ends and the MTT-task count paragraph begins.
Publisher DOCX supplement route was identified but could not be downloaded due a JavaScript/Cookie challenge.

stimulus_type.value: Pink-noise (1/f noise) auditory samples, presented either as a static flat sound or a dynamic looming sound.
stimulus_type.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-5, The PPS task and Figure 1
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The PPS methods identify pink-noise stimuli and flat versus looming sound classes.

source_provenance.value: Auditory stimuli were pink-noise samples sampled at 44.1 kHz; exact source file, noise seed, or waveform asset is not provided in the main PDF.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Sampling rate and stimulus class are reported; original files are not supplied.

trajectory_count.value: Two auditory condition families: static/flat sound and dynamic/looming approaching sound.
trajectory_count.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-5, The PPS task and Figure 1
trajectory_count.evidence_note: The task contrasts flat rectangular and looming triangular sound conditions.

trajectory_path.value: Two-speaker hand/body-centered path: near speaker about 10 cm from the right hand and far speaker 1 m from the participant's body; looming was implemented by far-speaker fade-out and near-speaker fade-in.
trajectory_path.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-5, The PPS task and Figure 1
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Near/far speaker locations and opposite intensity changes are reported.

stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration is explicitly reported in the PPS methods.

stimulus_speed.value: Approximate physical path length is about 90 cm over 3000 ms, implying about 30 cm/s if treated as a continuous looming path; the paper does not state speed directly.
stimulus_speed.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-5, The PPS task and Figure 1
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: Derived from reported 1 m far position, about 10 cm near position, and 3000 ms duration.

auditory_conditions.value: Flat sound with constant intensity and looming sound with increasing perceived approach; participants ignored the auditory stimulus while detecting tactile targets.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The two auditory conditions and ignore-sound instruction are reported.

gain_envelope.value: Looming intensity rose exponentially from 55 to 70 dB; flat sounds stayed at 62.5 dB. For looming, far speaker decreased to silence while near speaker increased to maximum.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Main methods give dB endpoints and the two-speaker cross-intensity pattern.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two physical loudspeakers delivered the auditory stimuli, one near the right hand and one far from the participant; no HRTF or headphone renderer was used.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The speaker geometry is shown in Figure 1 and described in the PPS task text.

trial_rows_families.value: PPS trial families included audio-tactile target trials, auditory-only catch trials with flat or looming sound, and unimodal tactile baseline trials.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The PPS methods define the 60% target family and the 40% catch/baseline remainder.

condition_intermixing.value: The PPS task mixed audio-tactile targets with auditory-only catches and unimodal tactile baselines within one PPS task; exact trial-order algorithm is not reported.
condition_intermixing.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-5, Design and The PPS task
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Trial-family proportions are reported, but not the internal schedule algorithm.

blocked_or_random_order.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-6; publisher supplement route checked 2026-06-16
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: PPS-versus-MTT task order was balanced, but no PPS block count, block order, or trial randomization rule was found.

iti_jitter_policy.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-6; publisher supplement route checked 2026-06-16
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: No PPS ITI, jitter value, jitter range, or distribution was found; the 1000 ms interval belongs to the separate MTT task.

response_window.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-6; publisher supplement route checked 2026-06-16
response_window.evidence_note: Fast keyboard response is reported, but no PPS timeout, response deadline, or scoring window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants responded as fast as possible to tactile targets with the left index finger on a keyboard, ignored auditory stimuli, and repeated a trial if they failed to answer.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The response rule, ignore-sound instruction, and failed-answer repetition rule are reported.

tactile_stimulus.value: Single constant-voltage rectangular monophasic pulse via DS3 Digitimer electrical stimulators and electrode pairs on the hairy surface of the right index finger.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Main methods report tactile modality, stimulator model, waveform class, and body site.

soa_table.value: D1-D5 tactile delays after auditory onset: 300, 800, 1500, 2200, and 2700 ms.
soa_table.evidence_note: The five PPS tactile delays are explicitly listed.

baseline_strategy.value: Unimodal tactile baseline trials were delivered during silence periods before sound administration to control expectancy.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The paper states the baseline purpose and no-sound context.

baseline_timing.value: D0 tactile-only baseline occurred at -700 ms, preceding sound administration during silence.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: The D0 baseline timing is explicitly reported.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory-only catch trials used either looming or flat sounds, with no tactile target.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch trials are described as auditory stimulation only.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-6 and PPS results; publisher supplement route checked 2026-06-16
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: No exact repetition count per D1-D5 tactile delay and flat/looming condition was found.

baseline_count.page_or_section: PDF p.5 and PPS results; publisher supplement route checked 2026-06-16
baseline_count.evidence_note: Baseline trials are reported, but the exact baseline count or baseline-specific percentage is not.

catch_count.page_or_section: PDF p.5 and PPS results; publisher supplement route checked 2026-06-16
catch_count.evidence_note: Auditory-only catches are reported as part of the 40% remainder, but exact catch count/split is not.

block_count.value: The study had two same-day sessions, the PPS task and MTT task, with task order balanced across participants; no internal PPS block count is reported.
block_count.page_or_section: PDF p.4, Design and experimental procedure
block_count.evidence_note: Session count and task-order balancing are reported.

total_trial_count.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-6 and PPS results; publisher supplement route checked 2026-06-16
total_trial_count.evidence_note: No PPS total trial count was found; the 72-trial count belongs to the separate MTT task.

critical_caveats: The exact PPS total trial count is not reported in the main PDF.
The exact repetitions per tactile delay and auditory condition are not reported.
The exact split between auditory-only catch trials and D0 unimodal tactile baselines is not reported.
No PPS ITI, jitter, or trial randomization algorithm is reported.
No numeric PPS response window or timeout is reported.
Tactile calibration details are deferred to supplementary materials, but the publisher DOCX supplement was blocked by a JavaScript/Cookie challenge.
The exact original pink-noise files/noise seed and gain files are not supplied.
next_manual_action: Ask the user to download the Sage DOCX supplement for this DOI into artifacts/paper_metadata_audit/supplements/depersonalisation_2024/. The supplement may resolve tactile calibration and possibly trial-count details.
